tasks.title: Task #6a — Caption Generator agent scaffold (config + index)
tasks.context: Phase 1 — TikTok Content Agent — Task #6. Pipeline step 3 of 4: after VisionScorer produces ScoredMediaItem[], CaptionGenerator takes the top-N items by score and generates TikTok-optimized captions using qwen3:14b via Ollama. The ScoredMediaItem interface is redeclared locally (not imported) to avoid circular deps. Fallback caption and hashtags are hardcoded for error cases so the pipeline never gets stuck. The pipeline runner (075-03) imports CaptionedItem and CaptionGenerator from this module.

tasks.title: Task #6b — TikTok Client agent scaffold (config + index)
tasks.context: Phase 1 — TikTok Content Agent — Task #6. Pipeline step 4 of 4: TikTokClient wraps the TikTok Content Posting API v2 (PULL_FROM_URL mode). No file upload needed — TikTok fetches media directly from the archive.org URL. Default privacyLevel is SELF_ONLY (private) so posts are safe to test without going public. Set TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN in .env to enable real posting — without it the client auto-switches to dry-run mode. The PULL_FROM_URL approach works for public URLs (archive.org items are public). API reference: POST /v2/post/publish/content/init/ for photos, POST /v2/post/publish/video/init/ for videos. Response: { data: { publish_id }, error: { code, message } }.

tasks.title: Task #6c — TikTok pipeline runner script (full end-to-end)
tasks.context: Phase 1 — TikTok Content Agent — Task #6. Pipeline runner ties all 4 agent steps together: ArchiveScraper (Task #4) → VisionScorer (Task #5) → CaptionGenerator (Task #6a) → TikTokClient (Task #6b). CLI flags allow iterating on the query, score threshold, and count without code changes. --dry-run is critical for testing without posting to TikTok. Output JSON saved to reports/tiktok-pipeline-{timestamp}.json for review. This is the FIRST revenue-enabling script — running this end-to-end with a real TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN constitutes Task #6 complete. Next step after this sprint: set TIKTOK_ACCESS_TOKEN in .env and run: npx ts-node scripts/run-tiktok-pipeline.ts --query 'vintage 1970s' --dry-run
